Semantic radar Building overview
Click nodeDrag to pan

Semantic radar needs more MAP space.

Zero Module Coupling

  • Identity never references Entitlements; Entitlements never writes Identity tables
  • Core.Application owns IPermissionCatalogCache, IFeatureChecker, FeaturePackExpansion & PermissionResourceNormalizer
  • All 16 SubscriptionChangedEvent publishers respect TenantFeatureOverrides & Base EditionName

Fail-Closed Defense-in-Depth

  • UseTenantContextValidation executes before RequireMfaEnrollment & UseAuthorization
  • PermissionAuthorizationHandler checks live IFeatureChecker even on unexpired JWTs
  • HttpFeatureChecker fails closed (false/0) on transport exceptions

SCRIPE Internal Tenant Invariants

  • 490 catalog perms -> 69 PlatformOnly blocked, 32 Plugins/Marketplace off, 389 active
  • 16 Roles (Priority 0..900 ascending) & 10 UserGroups (zero all_tenants, zero passwords)
  • Read-preferred role FLS intersection + additive GRP_SCRIPE_PII_MASKED union
